title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.53
subtitle: PATTERN NeXt: draw garments, get cloth.

highlights.title: PATTERN NeXt workspace
highlights.description: Draw patterns in a locked 2D editor next to your 3D view. Polygon, Rectangle, Ellipse and Curve tools, point and curve editing, snapping and measurements.

highlights.title: Filled the moment you close it
highlights.description: Every pattern becomes a triangulated Cloth NeXt cloth panel at your Particle Distance, and seams you draw become Cloth NeXt sewing.

highlights.title: AETHER Engine (experimental)
highlights.description: The native GPU cloth engine for Live Simulation and Bake is included. Choose AETHER as the Engine on Windows with an NVIDIA GPU.
